Suresh Agarwal
Backend Engineer | Kolkata
suresh.agarwal147@example.com | +91 9554823524

Experienced backend developer focused on building scalable, reliable services in Go. Comfortable working across the full service lifecycle from design to deployment, with hands-on expertise in containerization and stream processing. Open to relocating to Chennai or Delhi NCR.

Experience

Quanta Retail — Nov 2024 - Present
Go Developer (Remote)
- Implemented containerized order-processing pipelines using Docker, reducing startup time of service replicas by 40% and improving deployment consistency across environments.
- Developed high-throughput event producers and consumers with Apache Kafka for inventory change streams, achieving sustained 20k events/sec ingestion and 99.95% delivery reliability.
- Built Go-based worker services that interact with Redis for fast session and cache storage, cutting average latency for inventory lookups from 120ms to 35ms.
- Instrumented services with Prometheus metrics and Linux-level resource tuning, enabling alerting that reduced incident detection time by 60%.

CartNest — Aug 2023 - Oct 2024
Go Developer (On-site)
- Designed and implemented Microservices for cart and checkout flows in Go, improving system modularity and enabling independent deployments that reduced release lead time by 50%.
- Integrated gRPC service-to-service communication for synchronous checkout operations, lowering RPC latency to sub-10ms p95 and simplifying client stubs across teams.
- Leveraged Redis for distributed locks and session management to prevent double-checkout scenarios, decreasing checkout conflicts by 95%.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints, documented APIs and runbooks in Confluence, and contributed Prometheus metrics to track service health and SLO compliance.

Projects
- Real-time Inventory Dashboard: Developed a lightweight Go service that subscribes to Apache Kafka topics and aggregates inventory metrics, exposing Prometheus metrics and a minimal HTTP endpoint for dashboarding; supported 5k topics with low memory footprint.
- gRPC Pagination Library: Created a small Go library to standardize paginated gRPC responses and error handling across microservices, adopted by two internal teams to simplify client implementations.
